sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: No supplied candidate defines an owner-compatible component or tank path/term with the required domain semantics; the quantity properties remain insufficient to resolve the reported domain mismatch.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the universal tank-level logic. The candidate uses invented string alternatives for tankType instead of the supplied canonical oilResidueTank and oilyBilgeWaterHoldingTank class terms, and it places unpaired capacity, type, and separation values directly on the ship.
